description:
**Reporting To:**
=================

Senior Human Resources Business Partner

**Shift:**
==========

India Standard (India)

**About Russell Investments, Mumbai:**
======================================

Russell Investments is a leading outsourced financial partner and global investment solutions firm providing a wide range of investment capabilities to institutional investors, financial intermediaries, and individual investors around the world. Building on an 90-year legacy of continuous innovation to deliver exceptional value to clients, Russell Investments works every day to improve the financial security of its clients. The firm is “Top 12 Ranked Consultant (2009-2024)” in P&I survey 2024 with $1,013 billion in assets under advisement (as of June 30, 2026) and $417.5 billion in assets under management (as of June 30, 2026) for clients in 30 countries. Headquartered in Seattle, Washington in the United States, Russell Investments has offices around the world, including London, New York, Toronto, Sydney, Tokyo, Shanghai, and Mumbai.

Joining our Mumbai office means becoming part of a globally connected team where associates collaborate across functions, geographies, and time zones to support the work of a globally recognized asset management firm. Based in Goregaon (East), you will have the opportunity to work alongside colleagues around the world, contribute to meaningful initiatives, and build your career in a collaborative and inclusive environment. The Mumbai office operates with varying shifts to support collaboration across global time zones.

For more information, please visit https://www.russellinvestments.com.

**Job Description:**
====================

Russell Investments is looking for an experienced Talent Acquisition leader to manage recruitment delivery across our India business.

Our Mumbai office is Russell Investments' largest global location, supporting a diverse range of functions including Investment Division, Global Technology, Global Operations, GTM, Marketing and corporate services.

This role will lead a team of recruiters responsible for hiring across both technology and non-technology functions, with particular emphasis on specialist and technically complex roles.

We are looking for someone who combines hands-on recruitment expertise with strong business acumen, market intelligence and a data-driven approach. The successful candidate will independently manage TA operations, build a high-performing recruitment team and partner with business leaders to deliver effective hiring solutions.

The role will also work closely with the Global Talent Acquisition team to support the implementation of our evolving global TA strategy and operating model.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Talent Acquisition Delivery & Operations**

* Lead end-to-end recruitment delivery across technology and non-technology functions in India, ensuring hiring priorities are met while maintaining high standards of candidate quality.
* Independently manage recruitment operations, including recruiter allocation, hiring priorities, workload management and escalations.
* Partner with hiring managers and HR Business Partners on workforce requirements, hiring strategies, role expectations and recruitment challenges.
* Drive recruitment efficiency through effective intake discussions, proactive pipeline management, timely stakeholder communication and adherence to agreed service standards.
* Work closely with the Global Talent Acquisition team to implement the global TA strategy, strengthen regional collaboration and drive consistency in recruitment practices.
* Manage recruitment agencies and external partners, ensuring quality, cost effectiveness and appropriate utilisation.

**2. Specialist & Technical Recruitment**

* Personally lead recruitment for selected critical, senior and technically complex roles, particularly across Technology and Investment-related functions.
* Demonstrate strong understanding of technical talent markets, including software engineering, data, cloud, cybersecurity, AI and automation.
* Develop expertise in specialist investment talent segments such as quantitative analytics, investment risk, portfolio analytics and research.
* Build sourcing strategies for niche and hard-to-fill positions through direct sourcing, talent mapping and alternative talent pools.
* Provide market intelligence on talent availability, compensation benchmarks, competitor activity and emerging skill requirements to support informed hiring decisions.

**3. Team Leadership & Development**

* Lead, coach and develop a team of recruiters, building accountability, independence and consistency in recruitment delivery.
* Set clear expectations around recruiter productivity, hiring quality, stakeholder management and service standards.
* Conduct regular recruitment reviews, provide feedback and address performance or capability gaps within the team.
* Build functional expertise across the team and encourage knowledge-sharing between technology and non-technology recruitment verticals.
* Foster a culture of ownership, where recruiters proactively resolve challenges, manage stakeholders and make informed recommendations.

**4. Recruitment Analytics & Reporting**

* Own recruitment reporting and dashboards, providing visibility into hiring progress, pipeline health, time-to-fill, source effectiveness and recruiter productivity.
* Analyse recruitment data to identify trends, anticipate hiring challenges and recommend improvements to recruitment strategies.
* Present meaningful hiring insights and recommendations to HR and business leaders.
* Ensure data accuracy and reporting discipline across Workday and other recruitment systems.

**5. Process Improvement & Candidate Experience**

* Drive consistent adoption of recruitment processes, interview frameworks, assessment standards and hiring governance.
* Partner with hiring managers and HRBPs to improve interview effectiveness, candidate evaluation and hiring decisions.
* Identify opportunities to simplify recruitment workflows, improve turnaround times and reduce unnecessary administrative activities.
* Support the evaluation and adoption of AI-enabled recruitment tools, automation and sourcing technologies.
* Ensure a positive, transparent and professional experience for candidates and hiring managers throughout the recruitment process.
* Promote fair, inclusive and evidence-based hiring practices in line with company policies and applicable regulations.

**What You'll Bring**

**Essential Experience & Skills**

* Minimum 7 years of progressive experience in Talent Acquisition, including at least 3 years of direct people management experience.
* Proven experience managing recruitment delivery across both technology and non-technology functions.
* Strong hands-on technical recruitment experience, with the ability to independently manage complex and niche hiring requirements.
* Demonstrated ability to lead, coach and develop recruiters while managing multiple hiring priorities.
* Strong understanding of the Indian talent market, sourcing channels, compensation trends and specialist talent pools.
* Strong analytical skills, with experience using recruitment data to influence decisions and improve hiring outcomes.
* Experience partnering with senior business stakeholders, influencing hiring decisions and managing challenging recruitment situations.
* Experience with applicant tracking systems and recruitment reporting tools.
* Strong communication, negotiation, problem-solving and stakeholder-management skills.
* Ability to work independently, exercise sound judgement and take ownership of recruitment delivery.

**Preferred Experience**

* Experience recruiting within BFSI, investment management, asset management, fintech or global capability centres.
* Exposure to quantitative, investment analytics, risk or other specialist financial-services hiring.
* Experience working in a global or matrixed organisation, supporting stakeholders across multiple regions.
* Experience with Workday Recruiting, talent intelligence platforms, recruitment automation or AI-enabled sourcing solutions.
* Experience implementing recruitment process improvements or TA transformation initiatives.
* Advanced Excel, Power BI or similar data-visualisation capabilities.

**What Success Looks Like**

Within the first 3-6 months, we would expect you to:

* Establish strong ownership of day-to-day recruitment delivery, with minimal escalation required for routine hiring matters.
* Build a recruitment team that operates with greater independence, accountability and functional expertise.
* Develop credible relationships with hiring managers and HRBPs, providing proactive recruitment advice and market intelligence.
* Improve recruitment reporting, pipeline visibility and consistency in stakeholder communication.
* Demonstrate successful delivery of specialist and technically complex hiring requirements.
* Contribute to the implementation of global TA initiatives and identify opportunities to improve recruitment efficiency and candidate experience.

**Why Join Russell Investments?**

At Russell Investments, you will have the opportunity to work across a diverse range of business functions within a global investment solutions organisation.

This role offers exposure to specialist talent markets, global stakeholders and ongoing TA transformation initiatives, while providing the opportunity to shape recruitment delivery and develop a high-performing team.

You will play an important role in building the talent and capabilities that support our business in India and globally.

We are looking for an experienced and result-oriented US IT Recruiter to manage end-to-end technical recruitment, support US staffing delivery, and develop strong professional relationships with US IT staffing companies, prime vendors, implementation partners, MSPs, and enterprise clients.

The ideal candidate should have proven experience working in the US IT staffing industry, handling W2, C2C, 1099, C2H, and permanent hiring requirements, successfully placing candidates, and coordinating directly with client-side recruiters, account managers, and hiring managers.

We are particularly interested in professionals who have established relationships within the US IT staffing industry and can contribute to expanding FyerX's client and recruitment partner network through genuine business introductions and relationship development.

The candidate should be comfortable independently managing multiple requirements, building candidate pipelines, coordinating recruitment activities, and supporting client acquisition and vendor partnership initiatives across the US market.

* Manage end-to-end US IT recruitment activities, including sourcing, screening, shortlisting, interview coordination, offer follow-ups, and candidate onboarding.
* Handle technical recruitment requirements across W2, C2C, 1099, Contract-to-Hire (C2H), and permanent hiring engagements.
* Source and recruit IT professionals across ServiceNow, SAP, Salesforce, Oracle, Workday, Data & AI, Cloud, DevOps, Java, .NET, Python, and other enterprise technologies.
* Work closely with staffing clients, prime vendors, MSPs, account managers, and hiring teams to understand technical requirements, budgets, pay rates, bill rates, and timelines.
* Identify suitable candidates through Dice, Monster, CareerBuilder, LinkedIn, Indeed, job portals, professional networks, and internal recruitment databases.
* Conduct initial candidate screening to assess technical experience, project exposure, communication skills, compensation expectations, work authorization, and availability.

* Prepare and submit relevant candidate profiles with complete screening details and Right to Represent (RTR) confirmations wherever required.
* Coordinate interviews, candidate documentation, offer negotiations, background verification, and joining formalities.
* Build and maintain professional relationships with US IT staffing companies, prime vendors, MSPs, implementation partners, and enterprise hiring teams.
* Identify potential staffing clients and recruitment partners through professional networks, existing industry relationships, market research, and business development activities.

* Coordinate with the Business Development team to identify US onshore and India-based offshore staffing opportunities.
* Participate in client discussions, requirement clarification calls, vendor onboarding activities, and recruitment delivery meetings when required.
* Maintain accurate candidate records, client requirements, recruitment activities, and submission trackers using Zoho Recruit, ATS platforms, VMS, or Excel.
* Build and maintain an active network of qualified IT professionals for immediate and upcoming staffing requirements.
* Monitor US recruitment market trends, technology hiring demands, contract rates, and candidate availability.
* Meet assigned recruitment delivery, candidate submission, interview, closure, and client partnership targets.
* Maintain professionalism, confidentiality, compliance, and ethical standards when handling candidate information and client relationships.

* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field.

* 5–10 years of proven experience in US IT recruitment, technical staffing, recruitment delivery, or US IT staffing services.

* Strong experience working with US IT staffing companies, prime vendors, MSPs, implementation partners, or direct enterprise clients.

* Previous experience coordinating directly with US client-side recruiters, recruitment delivery managers, account managers, hiring managers, or vendor management teams.

* Established professional relationships within the US IT staffing industry and the ability to develop new client and recruitment partner relationships will be a significant advantage.

* Experience supporting staffing vendor partnerships, client acquisition, recruitment business development, or vendor empanelment activities is highly preferred.

* Strong recruitment experience across enterprise technologies such as ServiceNow, SAP, Salesforce, Oracle, Workday, Data & AI, Cloud, DevOps, Java, and .NET.

* Advanced sourcing experience using Dice, Monster, CareerBuilder, LinkedIn, Boolean searches, professional referrals, and recruitment databases.

* Familiarity with Zoho Recruit, Bullhorn, JobDiva, Ceipal, ATS platforms, vendor management systems, and recruitment trackers.

* Good understanding of US IT staffing commercial models, pay rates, bill rates, gross margins, placement fees, and recruitment delivery processes.

* Strong understanding of US work authorization categories, including H-1B, H-4 EAD, OPT, CPT, Green Card, and US Citizenship, along with compliant and non-discriminatory recruitment practices.

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English, with strong client coordination, negotiation, and relationship-management abilities.

* Ability to independently manage multiple technical requirements, prioritize urgent positions, and consistently meet recruitment delivery timelines.

* Strong ownership, professionalism, confidentiality, and the ability to work effectively in a remote environment during US business hours.

  
  

### **Benefits**

* Work-from-home opportunity with a growing technology staffing and recruitment services company.
* Opportunity to work with US IT staffing companies, prime vendors, MSPs, and enterprise clients.
* Performance-based incentives for successful recruitment closures and eligible new client acquisitions.
* Exposure to US onshore staffing and India-based offshore staffing engagements.
* Opportunity to contribute to FyerX's US staffing business expansion and client partnership development.
* Career growth opportunities based on recruitment performance, client relationship development, and business contributions.

If you have strong experience in US IT recruitment, a proven record of successful placements, and established professional relationships within the US IT staffing industry, we encourage you to apply for the **US IT Recruiter** role at **FyerX**.

* Serves as the initial point of contact for end-users seeking technical assistance in the areas of networking, collaboration tools, and end-user computing.

* **Analytical Thinking:** Analytical skills help in evaluating the potential impact of data projects on business outcomes and in making data-driven decisions.

**Accounts Payable Specialist II**

**Overview**

As a key member of the Accounting department, this Accounts Payable Specialist II will be reporting to the Accounts Payable Supervisor and is mainly responsible for assisting the AP Supervisor in processing invoices and issuing payments. The ideal candidate will ensure proper vendor account coding of invoices into the accounting system in accordance with established departmental guidelines in a timely, efficient and effective manner. They will also be responsible for processing check requests and verifying approval on all invoices. They will possess great organizational skills, the ability to prioritize, meet deadlines and multi-task while maintaining data input accuracy.

Accurate Background is a fast-growing organization, focused on providing employment background screenings and building trustful relationships with our clients. Accurate Background continues to exceed expectations by offering an array of innovative and cutting-edge background check and credentialing products to meet the needs of human resource, loss prevention, and security/legal professionals in employment screening and vendor certification.

* Handle vendor correspondence via mail, e-mail or phone.
* Respond promptly and professionally to internal and external inquiries regarding vendor invoices paid or unpaid.
* Maintain files and documentation in accordance with company policy and accepted accounting practices.
* Request new vendor accounts set-up and/or update of existing vendor records.
* Verify OCR accuracy of vendor invoices and forward for coding/approval.
* Initiate payments for all payment methods, gather all necessary back-up for the payments and record the payments in the accounting system.
* Daily bank reconciliation for all Disbursement accounts.

* Prepare/maintain reporting (SSRS reconciliation, Master Vendor List, Legal log, Cost breakdown by Location for International vendors).

We offer a fun, fast-paced environment, with lots of room for growth. We have an unwavering commitment to diversity, ensuring everyone has a complete sense of belonging here. description:
About the Role

Nirvasa Healthcare is looking for a proactive and result-oriented Talent Acquisition professional to manage and expand its alternate hiring channels across multiple hiring locations.

The incumbent will be responsible for building, managing and driving a robust external sourcing ecosystem comprising recruitment consultants, RPO partners, educational institutions, skill development centres, NGOs and other community-based sourcing channels.

This role will act as the central point of contact between external hiring partners and internal Site HR/Talent Acquisition teams, ensuring consistent candidate flow, partner productivity and achievement of hiring targets across all Nirvasa hiring centres.

Key Responsibilities:

1. Vendor & Consultant Management

* Identify, onboard and manage recruitment consultants, manpower agencies and RPO partners across different locations.
* Develop a strong network of external hiring partners to support ongoing and future manpower requirements.
* Drive partner productivity through regular follow-ups, performance reviews and target-based engagement.
* Monitor vendor-wise candidate submissions, interview conversions, joining ratios and overall hiring contribution.
* Ensure adherence to agreed commercial terms, service expectations and recruitment processes.
* Build long-term relationships with productive vendors while continuously identifying new sourcing partners.

2. Skill Centre, NGO & Institutional Partnerships

* Identify and establish partnerships with skill development centres, vocational training institutes, NGOs, employment agencies and other grassroots hiring networks.
* Explore partnerships with government-supported and private skill development initiatives to create sustainable talent pipelines.
* Develop structured sourcing and placement programmes with these institutions.
* Coordinate candidate mobilisation activities, job drives, placement events and walk-in campaigns.
* Build a database of potential institutional partners across all Nirvasa hiring locations.

3. Campus & Institutional Hiring

* Develop relationships with colleges, universities, vocational institutes and educational institutions.
* Drive campus hiring initiatives for fresher and entry-level requirements.
* Coordinate with placement officers and institutional representatives for candidate mobilisation.
* Organise campus drives, recruitment events and placement activities.
* Build a sustainable campus sourcing pipeline to support recurring business requirements.

Job Description

Sr. Executive – Alternate Channel & Vendor Management (Talent Acquisition)

4. Centralised Hiring Coordination

* Act as the central SPOC for all alternate hiring channels across Nirvasa's hiring centres.
* Coordinate with respective Site HR Managers to understand manpower requirements, hiring priorities and location-specific challenges.
* Ensure external partners receive timely updates on open positions, candidate requirements, interview schedules and selection feedback.
* Monitor location-wise hiring progress and ensure adequate candidate pipelines.
* Facilitate seamless coordination between vendors, institutional partners and internal recruitment teams.

5. MIS, Performance Monitoring & Reporting

* Maintain a centralised database of all active vendors, consultants, RPOs, skill centres, NGOs and institutional partners.
* Track channel-wise and partner-wise sourcing performance, interview line-ups, selections, offers and actual joinings.
* Prepare periodic performance dashboards highlighting channel contribution, conversion ratios and partner productivity.
* Identify underperforming channels and recommend corrective actions.
* Share regular updates on hiring progress, partner engagement and sourcing challenges with the TA leadership.

Desired Candidate Profile

* Graduate in any discipline; MBA/PGDM in HR will be an added advantage.
* Minimum 3+ years of experience in Talent Acquisition, alternate channel hiring, vendor management or institutional recruitment.
* Prior experience managing recruitment consultants, manpower vendors, RPOs or external hiring partners.
* Exposure to campus recruitment, skill development centres, NGOs, vocational training institutes or community-based sourcing channels.
* Strong networking, relationship management and stakeholder coordination skills.
* Good understanding of bulk hiring and high-volume recruitment environments.
* Proficiency in MS Excel/Google Sheets and recruitment MIS.
* Strong follow-up, negotiation and execution capabilities.
* Willingness to travel across hiring locations for partner development and sourcing activities, as required.
